tests.name: Directory Traversal Protection

issues.title: Directory Traversal Vulnerabilities Found (19)
issues.remediation:
Add path validation:
- Use pathlib.Path.resolve() to normalize paths
- Verify resolved path is within allowed directory
- Reject paths containing .. or absolute paths
- Use whitelist of allowed file extensions
- Never use user input directly in file paths

tests.name: Deployment Artifacts Cleanup

issues.title: Leftover Deployment Artifacts (5)
issues.description: Found 5 deployment artifacts that should be removed
issues.remediation:
Clean deployment artifacts:
- Add patterns to .gitignore
- Use .dockerignore to exclude from containers
- Run: find . -name '*.pyc' -delete
- Run: find . -name '__pycache__' -type d -exec rm -rf {} +
- Remove .env.local, .env.development before deploy
- Use multi-stage builds to exclude dev files
